title: Account deletion was not failure-atomic
evidence: Mitigated in code and deployed: durable RLS-protected job records and a JWT-protected function. A post-test production query confirms no matching disposable Auth user, account, transaction, or avatar remains; the secret-scoped test execution log was not retained, so the success sequence is not independently evidenced. Failure/retry lifecycle remains unverified.
reproduction steps: Force auth deletion to fail after a successful Storage removal
recommended fix: Test failure/retry lifecycle against an isolated Supabase project

title: Production deletion and retention claims are not independently verified
evidence: The public Vercel page and privacy policy state 30-day support deletion, a further 30-day backup overwrite period, and 30-day support replies. Website source/deployment settings and the support-request workflow are absent from this workspace. Supabase reports no physical-backup data and PITR disabled, but WAL-G enabled; that does not establish a retention period. These public promises must be substantiated or removed before Play submission.
reproduction steps: Request deletion by email and inspect Vercel/support/Supabase retention controls
recommended fix: Obtain authoritative retention and support-process evidence then correct the published policy before Play submission
